info.title: Ferry
info.author: DanilKhmyrov
info.details:
Ferry turns your Switch into an FTP server so you can move files to and from it over Wi-Fi using any FTP client on the same network. It shows a live status screen with the console's address as a QR code, who is connected, and what is transferring and how fast.

You choose which filesystem to expose: the SD card (read/write), NAND's User partition (strictly read-only), installed games, or save data. Installed games appear as downloadable .nsp files assembled on the fly. Save data mounts read/write, so saves can be backed up and restored.

Ferry never installs anything and never writes to system storage. Uploaded .nsp/.nsz/.xci/.xcz files are simply stored on the SD card in a staging folder for you to install afterwards with DBI or another installer.

Up to 4 clients can transfer at once. An optional PIN can be required as the FTP password. Light and dark themes included.
